summary: JYE YEU ENTERPRISE Co., Ltd specializes in providing a range of fittings, tubes, valves, and rubber products, with a focus on engineering plastics like PTFE and PFA. Their offerings include customized products for hydraulic and pneumatic systems, which may serve ancillary roles in semiconductor applications.
